mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_delivery_log (config_id, analysis_id, symbol, market, recipient_hash, recipient_masked, status, message_id, error_message, sent_at) VALUES (#{configId}, #{analysisId}, #{symbol}, #{market}, #{recipientHash}, #{recipientMasked}, #{status}, #{messageId}, #{errorMessage}, #{sentAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_delivery_log SET status = 'PENDING', message_id = NULL, error_message = NULL, sent_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'SENT'

UPDATE stock_watch_delivery_log SET status = #{status}, message_id = #{messageId}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, sent_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SENT' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE sent_at END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM stock_watch_delivery_log WHERE config_id = #{configId} GROUP BY status
